A_signal_hit.definition: hits / issued official signals contained in verified full packs (on-time and late), judged by LANIAKEA-ISSUED-FIRST-TRADE-V3 on the public Binance tape; TSA_BEFORE_OUTCOME and unresolved-at-expiry rules unchanged
A_signal_hit.scope_note: hit of issued, verifiable signals; not a continuity score — read together with B

B_coverage.scope: official tokens of the due days as of the evaluation instant; declared outages listed with signed reference and duration

C_contract_score.definition: hits / denominator including every contractual penalty, per contract version of each day (V4.1 before 2026-10-21, V4.2 from 2026-10-21); printed with the rules version

diagnostics_published: per figure: insufficient tape, current-judge rejudge mismatches, legacy-judge differences (total, direction, timing-only; differences against legacy pack resolution fields, not prediction errors), timing and expired misses, the Binance tape file manifest and the executed verifier sha256
presentation_rule: A, B and C are always published together.

statuses.FINAL: integrity PASS, market rejudge PASS for this figure, no pending day, rules authenticated
statuses.HOLD: integrity HOLD, rules HOLD, or this figure has insufficient tape or a current-judge mismatch
statuses.PROVISIONAL: a due day is still LATE_PENDING
statuses.UNRELEASED_REHEARSAL: the V4.2 amendment, this metrics document or the verifier release is not yet admitted
